keyFindings.description: Lines 2985-2986: a role that lost the workload name is told to delete only the one it started, but not how to tell which; the name is the `workload:` line of `$TMPDIR/sequence.*.log`, which survives a pod loss on the issue's volume. Wording; the named fast-follow.
Size line says +307/-106; the diff outside `.legion/` is +305/-104 (kubernetes.md +282/-92, the LEGION-578 note +5/-4, tools.md and its generated copy +9/-4 each).

settled: Architect's lean (PR comment 6397454895) on the tester's WB observation, a background child left by the work holding the flock re-attach: not a defect, no change. The page already gives the escape (`cat` of the log shows `sequence: exit`), the child stays in the sequence's process group so the deliberate `kill -TERM -- -<process>` ends it, and a TERM before the sequence ends runs the trap; only SIGKILL loses the clean-up, which the page names. No child issue: nothing is wrong to fix.
